modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Indirect Speech Patterns
modules.instructions: Master reported questions (wh-/yes-no), orders/requests with infinitives, and modal verb transformations. Understand statement word order in reported questions.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Complex Indirect Structures
modules.instructions: Write reported questions, polite requests, and advice using asked/wanted to know + if/whether/wh-word. Apply infinitive structures for commands.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Transformation Challenge Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice converting questions, commands, and modal statements to indirect form. Recognize statement vs. question word order.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Indirect Speech Vocabulary
modules.instructions: Apply question words, reporting verbs for requests, and modal transformations correctly in indirect contexts.
